title: Task-aware Kernel Stein certificates for R\'{e}nyi differential privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.23798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: R\`enyi differential privacy, based on R\`enyi divergence, has become a notion of choice for privacy guarantees. However, outside the Gaussian setting, R\`enyi divergence can be difficult to compute. In particular, R\`enyi differential privacy guarantees that exploit task-specific information, as in R\`enyi Pufferfish privacy, can be challenging. Here we use kernel Stein discrepancies based on escort distributions to provide certificates for R\`enyi differential privacy. By designing the kernel to focus on the relevant privacy directions, we also derive task-aware privacy certificates. We provide exact identities for Gaussian and Laplace mechanisms and bounds for exponential mechanisms, with separate task-aware guarantees. A real data set example illustrates how the protected comparison set and the released subspace jointly determine the resulting certificates.

translated_title: 面向任务的核Stein证书用于Rényi差分隐私
translated_abstract: 基于Rényi散度的Rényi差分隐私已成为隐私保证领域的重要概念。然而，在高斯设定之外，Rényi散度可能难以计算。特别是，利用任务特定信息的Rényi差分隐私保证（如Rényi Pufferfish隐私中的情形）可能具有挑战性。本文使用基于护航分布的核Stein差异来为Rényi差分隐私提供证书。通过设计核函数聚焦于相关的隐私方向，我们还推导出了面向任务的隐私证书。我们为高斯机制和拉普拉斯机制提供了精确恒等式，并为指数机制提供了界，同时给出了独立的面向任务保证。一个真实数据集的例子说明了受保护的比较集和发布的子空间如何共同决定所得的证书。
tldr: 本文提出基于护航分布的核Stein差异方法，通过设计聚焦相关隐私方向的核函数，为Rényi差分隐私提供可计算的隐私证书及面向任务的隐私保证，并给出了高斯与拉普拉斯机制的精确恒等式和指数机制的界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes kernel Stein discrepancies based on escort distributions to provide computable certificates for Rényi differential privacy, deriving task-aware privacy guarantees by designing kernels focused on relevant privacy directions, with exact identities for Gaussian and Laplace mechanisms and bounds for exponential mechanisms.
